pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: Ritual Braziers hold the ingredients used by Nature's Ritual. Place them in the cardinal directions around a Ritual Table, then prepare each brazier with the required item and salt.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: A prepared brazier stores one ritual ingredient and can be salted. When the ritual succeeds, its contents are consumed and the brazier returns to an idle state.
